followUp.description: An offer: a follow-up the character is offered, derived or ephemeral, with an action to start, changes to apply or a linked character to make.

id.description: The offer's ID, which startAction's `action.followUp` takes: for an ephemeral offer its stored ID (which `dismissFollowUp` and `clearFollowUp` take too); for a derived one the follow-up's ID, with `@<instance ID>` when it is on a copy.

kind.description: `derived` (a `while` follow-up, offered exactly while its condition holds; never stored or dismissed) or `ephemeral` (an `on` or `becomes` follow-up, stored until acted on or dismissed; a `becomes` one also until its condition is false).

followUp.description: The follow-up's ID: `<pack>:<id>` for the rules', `<content or type qualified ID>#<id>` for content's.

source.description: For a follow-up declared on content: the content and copy it comes from, as computeSheet's sources name them.

to.description: `self`, or `{ link }` with the qualified slot ID.

character.description: For `to: { link }`: the ID of the character filling the slot, absent when it is empty.

action.description: The action to start, in the shape of startAction's `action` input, with `followUp` set to this offer's ID for the character's own offer: for an ephemeral one, the run then proposes the clearing change.

params.description: With `action`: the parameters the follow-up fixes, evaluated (for an ephemeral offer, when it fired). Others are the app's to supply.

changes.description: The changes to apply, resolved on the current character, for a new applyChanges batch. For the character's own ephemeral offer they end with `clearFollowUp`, so applying them clears it.

create.description: A derived offer to make a linked character: make a character file with `creating: true` using `pack`, run the creation start `start` on it with `params` (guided, or automatic when the start is `random`), apply its changes, and save the new character's ID in this character's `links` under `link`, which ends the offer. Never with `action` or `changes`.

start.description: The creation start, `<pack>:<id>`: the ruleset's `creation` entry with that `pack` and `id`.

pack.description: The start's pack: the pack the new character uses.

params.description: The start's action's parameters the offer fixes, evaluated on this character; pass them over the start's own `params`.

required.description: Whether the rules mandate it. Advisory: the engine blocks nothing, and an ephemeral one can still be dismissed.

cause.description: For an ephemeral offer from `on`: the adjustment entry that triggered it, as the follow-up's formulas saw it as `change` (with `once`, the matching entries summed), and its field. Absent for `becomes` and derived offers.

strict.description: Strict mode: rules issues become errors and the batch is rejected.

changes.description: The batch as applied: each `adjust` whose incoming-change effects rolled dice carries every face it used in `faces`, supplied and rolled. Apps log this, not their input, so a replay never rolls. A batch that rolled nothing comes back unchanged.

adjustments.description: What adjust changes actually did after incoming-change effects, absorption, overflow and clamping: one entry per field touched, in order. A change aimed at copies by query adds `{ copies }`: the instance IDs it matched, in order (empty when none matched); one aimed at applied entries by query adds `{ applied }` the same way, and an `applyEffect` merged into an existing entry (`reapply`) adds `{ applied: [<that entry's ID>] }`. An incoming-change effect's `then` adds `{ entry, key, value, source }` per state change it made to its own entry, and `{ entry, removed: true, source }` when it removed its applied entry.

by.description: The change actually applied to this field.

requested.description: The amount before effects, absorption and clamping, on the field the change named.

taken.description: On the `requested` entry: the amount after incoming-change effects and before absorbing, clamping and overflow. It differs from `requested` only when an incoming-change effect counted.

rolled.description: On the `requested` entry: each dice `add` an incoming-change effect rolled, in instance order, with the effect's source, the dice as text, every face it used and the total.

anyOf.description: A state change an incoming-change effect's `then` made to its own entry (a copy or an applied entry), after the adjust's own entries.
An applied entry an incoming-change effect's `then` removed (`removeEffect`), after the adjust's own entries.

followUps.description: The ephemeral follow-ups this batch stored, as computeSheet's `offers` lists them, in the order they were stored: the rules' in declaration order, then content's in instance order, each `on` follow-up once per matching adjustment in order. They are in the returned character too. Nothing here has been run or applied.
